XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Device: Electric power steering (steering column)

  • Fault: The steering suddenly becomes stiff due to the deactivation of the electric power steering. The problem occurs sporadically in the early stages, but tends to worsen until the system is completely deactivated.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: C1002 (steering column motor torque sensor)

  • Cause: Internal failure of the electric power steering system

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the entire steering column.

  • Procedure: - -
